top_signals.title: Think You Know ETFs? Bloomberg News Quiz Pointed Live from ETFs in Depth
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg’s news quiz show, Pointed, took the stage at the 2026 Bloomberg ETFs in Depth conference in New York for a battle of ETF knowledge. Bloomberg’s Katie Greifeld and Eric Balchunas went head-to-head with their teams F/m Investments’ Alexander Morris and Baird Strategas' Todd Sohn, testing their knowledge of the trends, stories and market developments shaping the ETF landscape. Watch the replay and see how your ETF knowledge stacks up against the experts. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Why the Next Bioterrorists May Not Make the Same Mistakes as Aum Shinrikyo
top_signals.summary:
In conversations with law enforcement and security professionals, one view has repeatedly emerged: Aum Shinrikyo’s failed biological weapons program in the early 1990s shows that the risk of bioterrorism is overstated, despite warnings about AI-assisted bioterrorism and calls for enhanced preparedness from experts, philanthropists, and CEOs of AI companies. The Japanese doomsday cult responsible for the 1995 Tokyo sarin attack had money, facilities, scientifically educated members, and a leadership willing to cause mass harm. top_signals.title: U.S. natural gas inventories end injection season above normal levels
top_signals.summary: Working natural gas in storage in the Lower 48 states ended the natural gas injection season at 3,810 billion cubic feet (Bcf), exceeding the five-year average by almost 2%, according to estimates based on data from our Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report released on November 12. Injection season runs April 1–October 31, the months of typically lower natural gas demand.
